query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. A newly added regression test passes on the fixed branch, but nobody ran it before the fix or mutated/reversed the fix. All existing tests also pass. Is this sufficient Testing & Code Verification evidence?
baseline_failure: Production incident: an agent added a test after implementation, saw green, and treated that as regression proof even though the assertion could also pass without the fix.
expected_behavior: Runs the named check without/reversing the fix and requires the expected semantic failure
Records both the negative proof and final green command before the testing gate passes
anti_expectation: Does not accept a syntax, fixture, or environment error as the required RED
Does not weaken the assertion merely to manufacture a failure
